standard_prerequisites.name: Validity of tautological and K instances
standard_prerequisites.statement: Tautological instances are valid in every class of models, and instances of the K axiom are valid in every class of models.
standard_prerequisites.use: The induction basis handles length-1 proofs of the first two kinds by these validity facts.

standard_prerequisites.name: Soundness of MP and Necessitation
standard_prerequisites.statement: If C implies B and C are valid in a class of models then so is B, and if C is valid in a class then so is Box C.
standard_prerequisites.use: The inductive step closes the modus ponens and Necessitation cases by these preservation facts.

standard_prerequisites.name: Class inclusion
standard_prerequisites.statement: If a formula is valid in a class C_i and C is a subclass of C_i, then it is valid in C.
standard_prerequisites.use: The basis case passes from validity of an A_i instance in C_i to validity in the intersection class.

core_obligations: Statement (lines 1460-1467): if every instance of A_1,...,A_n is valid in the classes of models C_1,...,C_n respectively, then K A_1 ... A_n proves B only if B is valid in the intersection class C_1 cap ... cap C_n.

Induction basis (proof lines 1471-1481): a proof of length 1 is a tautological instance, a K instance, or an instance of some A_i; the first two are valid in any class (prop:valid-taut, prop:Kvalid), and an A_i instance valid in C_i is valid in the intersection by class inclusion (prop:subset-class).

Inductive step (proof lines 1483-1496): a proof of length k>1 ends in MP from C implies B and C, or in Necessitation from C with B = Box C; both premises have shorter proofs and are valid in the intersection by the induction hypothesis, and B is valid there by the soundness of MP (prop:soundMP) resp. of Necessitation (prop:Nec-rule).
proof_roadmap: Set up induction on proof length with the intersection class fixed.
Dispatch the basis cases by the validity of axiom instances and class inclusion.
Close the MP and Necessitation cases by their validity-preservation facts.
